subject: Add test warning to PR template?

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Add test warning to PR template?
parts:
Can we add a warning to run tests in the PR templates? In
particular a reminder to run the cpplint tests _before_ waiting
for Jenkins to flag whitespace it finds objectionable?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Add test warning to PR template?
parts:
Sure. The pull request template is actually in the code base:
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/blob/develop/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

Want to create a PR to change it with whatever language you think is clear?

parts:

code and CC-BY license for doc with pull requests (and change
BSD to whatever governs the repo --- all noted on the mc-stan.org
page).

- Bob
